name: tooltip-card
title: Tooltip Card
blurb: Tooltip that follows the cursor and intelligently repositions to stay visible…
description: Custom tooltip that tracks mouse position and displays content with automatic edge detection and repositioning. Supports both mouse and touch events with spring-animated height transitions.
use_when: Tooltips with rich content that need to follow cursor movement and adapt to screen edges.
avoid_when: Simple text hints; the component is feature-rich and may be overkill for basic labels.
a11y: Content is shown on hover or touch; not keyboard-accessible. Touch shows tooltip for 2 seconds then hides.
